title: FCOS3D (nuScenes-pretrained) zero-shot on TruckScenes mini_val: mAP 0.0, real domain-gap finding
dataset: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini, mini_val split (2 scenes, 80 samples, official split via truckscenes.utils.splits)
sensor_configuration: Single camera only (CAMERA_LEFT_FRONT) of TruckScenes' 4-camera/6-lidar/6-radar suite — a CPU-runtime scope cut, not a data gap; all 80 samples' ground truth is still scored
annotation_schema: TruckScenes 12-class detection taxonomy (eval/detection/README.md remap of the 27-class general taxonomy)
split: mini_val, all 80 samples (ground truth); predictions from CAMERA_LEFT_FRONT only
model: FCOS3D (mmdetection3d 1.4.0), ResNet-101-caffe+DCN+GN head, official nuScenes-pretrained checkpoint fcos3d_r101_caffe_fpn_gn-head_dcn_2x8_1x_nus-mono3d_20210715_235813-4bed5239.pth — zero-shot, no fine-tuning or training on TruckScenes
conditions: unknown — no weather/scenario filtering applied, mixed conditions across the split's 2 scenes

environment.hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 5700U with Radeon Graphics — no NVIDIA GPU, no CUDA path (CPU-only inference)

commands: python truckscenes_fcos3d_infer.py --dataroot <man-truckscenes> --version v1.2-mini --split mini_val --config <fcos3d config .py> --checkpoint <fcos3d .pth> --cameras CAMERA_LEFT_FRONT --start 0 --end 15 --out results_mini_val_fcos3d.json
(repeated with --start/--end sliding across 15/30/45/60/75/80 — see experiment-log/0006 for the full chunking rationale)

metrics.name: mAP
metrics.scope: TruckScenes 12-class detection taxonomy, mini_val split, center-distance thresholds {0.5, 1, 2, 4}m averaged per detection_cvpr_2024.json config, single camera coverage

notes: Review update 2026-09-06: the saved evaluator reports mAP 0.0 for an 80-token mini_val submission with 959 boxes in 63 nonempty entries and 17 empty entries. The author reports processing all 80 samples, but the runner pre-fills empty entries; obtain chunk-completion logs to verify that those 17 frames were processed. This record preserves the scored submission, not independently verified inference completion. Camera-height/domain shift is a hypothesis, not a diagnosed cause: reference conversion code does not rule out calibration or integration errors. Check known geometry and same-camera visible ground truth before drawing a causal or range-degradation conclusion. Single-camera coverage and unsupported classes limit this protocol. Raw NDS is 0.0 and TP errors are 1.0; these do not establish measured range degradation. NDS/TP definitions were absent when the original run was written and are now present in docs/metrics-definitions.md. No new metric or inference was produced by this review. See experiment-log/0006-fcos3d-truckscenes-zeroshot.md for the preserved original account, review limitations and chunk retry fix.
